componentSets.name: App Name
componentSets.description: Product identity block for the Top Bar: App Icon plus name. 3 variants: type (vertical, horizontal, app). vertical stacks icon over name, horizontal sets them inline, app is the icon alone for narrow bars. Use only inside Top Bar and App Switcher; the name text is the link label.
